Products

Two engines. Three tools.

The engine

FRQTL

The physics engine that doesn't know any physics equations. Discrete fractal physics, integer rules, Rust compiled to WASM. Efficient enough to run the 3D double slit on an iPhone, offline. Same binary in the browser and headless in Node. For game-engine developers: a sprite is a quantum, a layer is a dimension, a tick is a tick.

npm i @descix/frqtl-web

Developer alpha of the SDK: after the preview, and it earns DAITA.

The arithmetic

EGPT Math

Bit-exact real and transcendental arithmetic in place of floating point. Matrices, polynomials, order-finding and transcendental functions on exact values, so error never accumulates.

npm i @descix/egpt-math-sdk

The builder

STUDIO

Drag-and-drop desktop physics. Emitters, walls, tunnels, detector walls and logic gates on a palette; a live 2D/3D canvas; layers and an inspector; every project is also code.

Open STUDIO ↗

The codec builder

ROSETTA

A visual flow canvas for building codecs on exact arithmetic, with the code drawer always in sync. Drop a transform, see the chain; edit the code, see the chain rebuild.

Open ROSETTA ↗

The notebook

FAT

Mathematica meets cellular automata, named with a nod to Lean. .frqnb notebooks with math, canvas, chart, view and module cells; the canvas cell is a live simulation. Same files in the browser and in VS Code.

Open FAT ↗

Which one do you need? Chip and hardware makers start with FRQTL and the FAT tier. Simulation teams take STUDIO and the engine. Codec and signal-processing teams take ROSETTA and EGPT Math. Research groups start in FAT.
